meta.title: Loving County — the money trail
meta.note: Loving County has 64 residents — the fewest of any county in the United States — and sits on top of the Permian Basin oil field. Its 2024 taxable value is $18,233,228,957, about 82% of it oil-and-gas mineral value: roughly $284,894,202 of taxable property per resident, almost certainly the highest of any US county. This tree is the property tax the county levies across its three tax-supported funds at a total rate of $0.46071 per $100. The county carries no debt and holds large reserves. Line-item appropriations live in the county’s adopted budget, which is a scanned PDF pending text extraction (see the docket); the levy figures here are each fund’s rate applied to the certified taxable value.
